tools.name: nomic_get_user
tools.description: Fetch the account the API key belongs to, including the organisations it can access. Start here — the organisation slug feeds the other tools. Atlas: GET /v1/user.

tools.name: nomic_get_organization
tools.description: Fetch an organisation by slug, with the datasets it holds. Atlas: GET /v1/organization/{slug}.

tools.name: nomic_get_dataset
tools.description: Fetch a dataset (Atlas calls it a project) by id — its schema, size, indices and projections. Atlas: GET /v1/project/{id}.

tools.name: nomic_get_dataset_by_slug
tools.description: Fetch a dataset by organisation slug and dataset slug — the human-readable path, and usually easier than finding the UUID. Atlas: GET /v1/project/{organization_slug}/{project_slug}.

tools.name: nomic_nearest_neighbors_by_id
tools.description: Semantic search: given the ids of records already in a dataset, return their nearest neighbours in embedding space, with distances. This is what Atlas is for — finding what resembles what across unstructured data. Needs a BUILT index; if the map is still building the call fails with a 500, so check

tools.name: nomic_get_index_job
tools.description: Fetch the status of an index-building job. Atlas indexes take time to build, and a vector search against an unbuilt map fails — this is how you tell which it is. Atlas: GET /v1/project/index/job/{job_id}.

tools.name: nomic_get_projection_schema
tools.description: Fetch the field schema of one projection — the columns available on its records. Atlas: GET /v1/project/projection/{projection_id}/schema.

tools.name: nomic_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags defined on one projection — the labelled selections a person made on the map. Atlas: GET /v1/project/projection/tags/get/all.

tools.name: nomic_get_tag_status
tools.description: Check whether a tag has finished computing its membership. A tag that is still building returns partial results. Atlas: GET /v1/project/projection/tags/status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nomic_get_user, nomic_nearest_neighbors_by_id · Private data: nomic_get_user, nomic_nearest_neighbors_by_id, nomic_get_projection_schema · Public sink: nomic_nearest_neighbors_by_id.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nomic_get_user, nomic_nearest_neighbors_by_id · Private data: nomic_get_user, nomic_nearest_neighbors_by_id, nomic_get_projection_schema · Public sink: nomic_nearest_neighbors_by_id

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
